questions.stem: A 34-week pregnant mother from South Delhi came to your clinic with a report of a decrease in urinary estriol excretion, indicating a decline in fetal adrenal cortical activity. Which of the following is the principal steroid secreted by the fetal adrenal cortex?
questions.solutionHtml:
Dehydroepiandrosterone
  • C: The fetal cortex synthesizes primarily dehydroepiandrosterone. Because it lacks 3β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase, the enzyme that converts pregnenolone to progesterone (the initial step in both glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid synthesis).



Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page No.768

questions.stem: Through what “permissive action” do glucocorticoids accelerate gluconeogenesis during fasting?

options.label: A
options.text: Glucocorticoids stimulate the secretion of insulin, which activates gluconeogenic enzymes in the liver.

options.label: B
options.text: Glucocorticoids inhibit the use of glucose by skeletal muscle.

options.label: C
options.text: Glucocorticoids maintain the vascular response to norepinephrine.

options.label: D
options.text: Glucocorticoids maintain the intracellular concentrations of many of the enzymes needed to carry out gluconeogenesis through effects on transcription.

questions.answerText: Glucocorticoids maintain the intracellular concentrations of many of the enzymes needed to carry out gluconeogenesis through effects on transcription.
questions.solutionHtml:
Glucocorticoids maintain the intracellular concentrations of many of the enzymes needed to carry out gluconeogenesis through effects on transcription.

Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page Number: 332.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is false?

options.label: A
options.text: 90% of the cortisol is bound to plasma proteins.

options.label: B
options.text: Cortisol has a half-life of 60-90 minutes.

options.label: C
options.text: Aldosterone has a half-life of about 20 minutes.

options.label: D
options.text: 80% of the aldosterone is bound to plasma proteins.

questions.answerText: 80% of the aldosterone is bound to plasma proteins.
questions.solutionHtml:
80% of the aldosterone is bound to plasma proteins.

60% of aldosterone is bound to plasma proteins, not 80%.




Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 13th Edition, Page no 967, 968.

questions.stem: Which of the following is not an action of cortisol?
questions.solutionHtml:
Increased number of T-lymphocytes

 Cortisol suppresses the proliferation of T-lymphocytes and decreases the number of T-Lymphocytes.




Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 13th Edition Page no. 972, 973, 974, 975, 976
